name: Moldova
description: Moldova from the principality of Moldavia and Stephen the Great to Russian Bessarabia, Soviet rule, independence in 1991, Transnistria and the road to Europe.

checkpoints.name: Moldavia
checkpoints.note: The principality of Moldavia was founded in the 1300s. Stephen the Great held off the Ottomans, but the land later paid them tribute.

checkpoints.name: Bessarabia
checkpoints.note: Russia took the land in 1812. It joined Romania in 1918 and was taken by the Soviet Union in 1940.

checkpoints.name: Independent Moldova
checkpoints.note: Moldova became independent in 1991, lost Transnistria in 1992 and began talks to join the EU in 2024.
